groups.saying_opens: من أتاه زائرا له عارفا بحقه
وحججت فدخلت على أبي عبد الله

notes: two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): the Baqir saying («من أتاه زائرا») and the encounter with al-Sadiq (Ibn Musadif's visit); both carry the same head through Muhammad b. Musadif, so both are written in full
«حدثني أبي وجماعة مشايخي» : the father is a bare relation and the shaykhs an unnamed group (rule 8); «عمن حدثه» is unnamed
in the second saying the Imam speaks inside the narrator's story: last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 5)
